description: Replace a note's WHOLE content, guarded by `expected_digest` from read_note (a stale digest fails with if-hash-mismatch rather than clobbering). Prefer patch_note_block for targeted prose/heading/list edits — this is the whole-file escape hatch. REFUSES to change a TaskNotes file's frontmatter title: that re-mints the task's corpus id, so a title change must go through update_task. Content above 5 MiB is refused. dry_run:true validates the guards WITHOUT writing.

dry_run.description:
Preview only — validate the guards + report the byte count
WITHOUT writing. The response carries `dry_run: true`.

expected_digest.description:
The `content_digest` from a prior `read_note`. REQUIRED — a
whole-file replace without compare-and-swap is a silent lost
update.

name: update_note
